title: Orange YOLO spatial mask recording arm (version 1)
description: recording_geometry_contract.json analytics_runtime.yolo_spatial_mask: how the YOLO spatial mask was armed for one recording, sealed with the recording. Written by the GUI (arm_gui_yolo_spatial_masks, src/orange.cpp; status armed, not_applicable_no_yolo_workers or failed, with apply_timeout_ms) and by the headless client (src/orange_headless_client.cpp; status armed_before_worker_start, with application_phase). cameras.<serial> holds each armed camera's orange.analytics.spatial_mask_runtime v1 policy, or the record of a camera whose policy did not resolve. A GUI start whose mask configuration did not resolve writes only schema_id, schema_version, status failed and error. The recording snapshot requires complete registration evidence when an armed mode is not off (update_recording_snapshot_geometry_contract_reference, src/project.cpp). Closed.

status.description: armed: every YOLO worker applied its policy before recording (GUI). armed_before_worker_start: the policies were requested before the workers started (headless). not_applicable_no_yolo_workers: no camera runs YOLO (GUI). failed: arming failed and the start was refused (GUI).

mode.description: The mode requested for every camera of the recording.

configuration_source.description: default_off: nothing requested a mode. environment: ORANGE_YOLO_SPATIAL_MASK_MODE. gui: the GUI's spatial mask panel.

apply_timeout_ms.description: GUI: how long each worker had to apply its policy.

application_phase.description: Headless: the policies are requested before the workers start.

cameras.description: Camera serial -> its policy, or the record of a policy that did not resolve.

allOf.description: An armed recording says how and for which cameras.
The GUI arms with a timeout.
The headless client arms before its workers start.

resolution_failure.description: A camera whose policy could not be resolved from the recording geometry contract.
